body_html:
@Johannes_Ernst but anyone tomorrow can go to Blogger, Medium, or WordPress and get a site and start their #IndieWeb journey. They can go to https://brid.gy and add webmentions to connect to rest of #IndieWeb

Barriers only high for those not willing to look up.
